security_audit.summary: Most external-command detections are Markdown backtick false positives, but the quick start confirms a critical curl-to-shell installer risk on line 16. The skill also uses remote inference services and lacks explicit consent guardrails for synthetic voice or avatar workflows.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl pipe-to-shell quick start with manual download, checksum verification, and explicit user confirmation before execution.

remediation.issue: External inference commands are presented without privacy warnings.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users that scripts, media URLs, prompts, and generated assets may be sent to inference.sh services.

remediation.issue: Synthetic voice and talking-head workflows lack consent guardrails.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear requirements for rights, consent, and a prohibition on impersonation or deceptive use.

remediation.issue: A hardcoded remote image is embedded in marketplace documentation.
remediation.suggestion: Host the image through a trusted marketplace asset pipeline or remove auto-loaded third-party media.

content.user_title: Generate AI Voice Narration with inference.sh
content.value_statement: Creating natural narration can require recording time and editing tools. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh voice generation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Lists supported inference.sh TTS models and common audio use cases.
Shows Kokoro voice IDs for American and British English voices.
Generates narration, dialogue, podcast host, and voiceover examples with infsh.
Explains chunking for long-form text and merging audio segments.
Combines generated audio with video or avatar workflows through media tools.
limitations: Requires an installed and authenticated inference.sh CLI.
Uses remote inference services, so output depends on service availability and account access.
Does not verify rights to voices, portraits, scripts, or video assets.
The quick-start installer uses a curl pipe-to-shell pattern that should be replaced.

use_cases.title: Produce Video Narration
use_cases.description: Generate short voiceovers and merge them with existing video assets.

use_cases.title: Create Course Audio
use_cases.description: Turn lesson scripts into paced narration with selected voices.

use_cases.title: Prototype Podcast Dialogue
use_cases.description: Create separate speaker tracks and merge them for draft podcast segments.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Short Voiceover
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to generate a 30-second voiceover from this script: [paste script]. Choose a clear professional voice and explain the selected model.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Voice Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three TTS variants for this paragraph using different Kokoro voices. Describe tone, pacing, and best fit for each.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Long Narration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Split this long script into safe chunks, recommend one consistent voice, and prepare generation steps for each chunk.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Multi-Speaker Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a two-speaker audio workflow for this dialogue, including voice choices, pacing notes, and merge steps.

output_examples.input: A product demo script that needs a calm narrator.
output: Voice: af_nicole for clear professional delivery.
Pacing: normal speed with short sentences and clear pauses.

output_examples.input: A ten-minute lesson script for an online course.
output_examples.output: The skill would propose chunk boundaries, a consistent voice, and merge guidance for a single narration track.

output_examples.input: A dialogue between host and guest for a podcast intro.
output: Speaker one uses a warm conversational voice.
Speaker two uses a brighter response voice.
Each speaker is generated separately before merging.

best_practices: Obtain written consent for any real person voice, likeness, portrait, or protected script.
Start with a short sample before generating long narration.
Use punctuation and speed settings to control pacing.
anti_patterns: Do not imitate a real person without permission.
Do not run remote installer commands without verifying the source and checksum.
Do not paste private scripts or regulated data into remote generation prompts.

faq.question: Does this skill clone a specific person?
faq.answer: The documented examples use preset TTS voices. Any real-person cloning or avatar use requires explicit rights and consent.

faq.question: Does it require inference.sh?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows depend on the inference.sh CLI and remote app services.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can it make long audiobooks?
faq.answer: It can plan chunked generation and audio merging. Very long projects still need review for consistency and rights.

faq.question: Is the installer safe to run automatically?
faq.answer: No. The quick start uses a curl pipe-to-shell command. Use verified manual installation instead.

faq.question: Does it create video avatars?
faq.answer: It includes a talking-head workflow using a portrait image and generated speech. Use it only with permitted images.
